text:
maya (marketing): Quick heads-up — planning to publish the hosted API release announcement next Tue 9:00am PT. Need: final changelog URL, docs anchor links, a short benchmark callout for the blog, webinar CTA, and inbound lead routing details. Will coordinate staged rollout (canary -> ramp -> all) and update the ops runbook.

alex (eng): Can we freeze changelog by EOD Fri? Tokenization/throughput benchmarks still validating across 8k seqs.

maya (marketing): EOD Fri works. Key is having a concise 'what's improved' blurb + one bench stat we can cite in the post.

sam (docs): I'm finishing the upgrade guide and example snippets. Will publish and drop anchor links by Mon morning (ETA Mon 15:00 PT).

chris (product): Webinar slot confirmed for Wed 11am PT — marketing to provide slide deck + demo script by Mon noon. Need a 10-min bench/demo segment and a CTA for registration.

alex (eng): Rollout plan: canary starts Tue 09:00 PT limited to 10% traffic; ramp at ~12:00 -> 50%; full at ~16:00. Auto-fallback to previous model if errors >1% or P95 latency increases >200ms.

maya (marketing): Who can paste the changelog permalink here when it's ready? Also need Sales Ops owner for inbound routing (webinar registrants, trial signups).

sam (docs): Changelog permalink will be https://docs.redwood.inference/changelog/release-2026-03-31 — I'll post final when published.

chris (product): I'll loop in Sales Ops. Proposed routing: webinar registrants -> SDR Queue A; trial signups with high usage -> AE Queue B; enterprise leads -> AE Queue C.

alex (eng): Deploy-bot will post deployment events to #release-war-room during rollout. Config snippet to be used by ops: 
```
canary: 10%
ramp: 50% at +3h
fallback: previous-model
alert_conditions:
  - error_rate > 1%
  - p95_latency_delta > 200ms
```

deploy-bot: [deploy] Canary started at 4998887776. Logs: https://internal.redwood/deploys/4998887776 :rocket:

maya (marketing): Thanks — action items: sam - post anchors by Mon; alex - confirm canary alert thresholds and escalation play; chris - confirm Sales Ops routing; marketing - draft blog + bench narrative by Mon EOD. Final preflight Tue 08:15am PT in #marketing. :thumbsup:
